svg.text: Flow 05 Online payment with QR Ph shown on the kiosk (partial)
Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
• PARTIAL: coded and covered by automated tests with PayMongo simulated, but not yet run with PayMongo keys; production has none yet, so the order takes
• The payment is recorded by whichever comes first, the kiosk's status check or PayMongo's payment.paid webhook; the other then changes nothing.
Recording marks it paid, deducts stock and confirms the order in one transaction; if stock ran out or the order was cancelled meanwhile, the payment is
recorded, nothing goes to the kitchen and the order is flagged STOCK ISSUE for staff.
• A succeeded intent is accepted only for the order's exact total. The idle reset is paused while the code can still be scanned and resumes when it
• In PayMongo test mode the screen offers a link to simulate the payment; test QR codes must not be scanned with a real banking app.
